descriptions.zh-Hans: 在大阪尝章鱼烧时写的卡片，菜名下面多了一行“再等一下”。这回菜单连等候也一并记下了。
descriptions.en: My Osaka takoyaki card has “a moment longer” beneath the name. It remembers the pause before the first bite too.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在大阪吃过大阪烧后写的卡片，暂时只有“今天这一份，记得”。第二句还在路上。
descriptions.en: After okonomiyaki in Osaka, my review reached “Remember this one.” The next sentence is still traveling.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在大阪城天守阁外和旅人碰面后留的两个小点。等人的一小段，刚好用来读介绍。
descriptions.en: Two dots for a meeting outside Osaka Castle Museum. The wait came with time for a little reading.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在大阪等章鱼烧凉一点时写的短句。把它圈起来，留给下次着急动筷子的自己。
descriptions.en: A circled line written while my takoyaki cooled in Osaka. A little reminder from one hungry moment to the next.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在大阪海游馆看鲸鲨时，原想写几笔，最后只留了一个点和一句“这里开始忘了写字”。
descriptions.en: A dot and “This is where I forgot to write,” saved from watching a whale shark at Kaiyukan in Osaka.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 把海游馆便签折进自制卡片，点旁添了一条弯线。打开时，可以再想起大阪那一片蓝。
descriptions.en: My Kaiyukan note tucked into a handmade card, a curved line added beside its dot. Open it for a little of that Osaka blue.
